cases.case_label: Founder Alu insertion in MAK in North American patients of Jewish ancestry with recessive retinitis pigmentosa
cases.ancestry_or_population: North American patients reporting Jewish ancestry
cases.mechanism_detail: A direct screen of 275 North American patients with recessive/isolate retinitis pigmentosa found the MAK Alu insertion homozygously in 25.7% of the 35 patients reporting Jewish ancestry (about 9 patients) and in 2.1% of patients of mixed ethnicity; haplotype analysis showed the allele is inherited by founder effect. The molecular consequence of the insertion is not investigated here.
cases.quote: We identified the MAK and DHDDS mutations homozygously in only 2.1% and 0.8%, respectively, of patients of mixed ethnicity, but in 25.7% and 8.6%, respectively, of cases reporting Jewish ancestry.
